comment: Scanned Japanese factory schematic of the Shin-ei 8-transistor Fuzz Wah (8 x 2SC828); no designators, parts listed by quantity. The 6P push switch is the effect selector footswitch and is skipped; pots are not named on the drawing.
uncertain: 22K at wah transistor base: could be 27K
100K at input transistor base may be a trimmer (arrow-like mark)
rows: one at the input transistor base may be drawn as a trimmer
one across the second transistor with 0.001uF, one in series with 10uF, one in the filter
the one at the wah transistor base reads 22K or 27K
no part number given; shunt clippers to ground
fuzz section pot (wired as variable resistor to a 10uF)
wah section pot between the two 0.2uF outputs
